caption:
You answer fast. They might think you're desperate.

That fear stops more owners from speeding up follow-up than cost ever does.

Only about 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour. Most prospects already expect to be ignored. A reply in minutes doesn't read as pushy. It reads as rare.

What actually sounds desperate is generic urgency: "Thanks for your interest!!! Call now!!!" on autopilot.

What sounds attentive is specific: naming their exact service and asking one real question.

Same five minutes. Completely different read.

See it work on your own leads. 14 days free, no card.

rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B objection content, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed 'fast reply looks desperate' fear using industry speed-to-lead research and a specific-vs-generic message contrast, distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, adoption, migration, and accuracy objection already shipped.
